correctness.rationale: PASS. For equal-color vacancy neighbors all m opposing agents would need two opposite neighbors, demanding m+1 agents of the endpoint type, impossible. With opposite endpoints, endpoint agents move to utility one and interior agents to 1/2, so a nonprofitable jump is exactly the stated run condition. Two interleaved color run compositions independently choose m-k length-two runs among k-1 free runs, and boundary edges add welfare 1/2 each beyond the 2k-1 unlike path edges. Every k in [ceil((m+1)/2),m] is attained, alternating word reaches welfare 2m. An independent fresh brute-force enumerator directly evaluated pre/post jump utilities and exact welfare for all 15,584 labeled-vertex color patterns at m=2..6; all predictions matched. This bounded check is corroboration, not the unbounded proof.
